decisions.mechanism: parallax of the merge. An interval continues from neighbour probes whose interval starts lie up to sqrt(3) spacings off the probe's own ray, while level 1 starts one spacing out. The rule that picks the neighbours sets the sign: the screen probe's segment test and sv 2 keep neighbours whose start lies in open space, and those see brighter surfaces than the probe's own ray (screen merges +3.5% without sv, +5.0% with it; level-0 merges +1.4% with sv 2). Without sv the merge keeps entries that start behind an occluder and reads dark (level 0: -5.7%). Exact screen rays (sx) remove 80% of the band and 1.15 of the 1.45 points of bias; exact rays everywhere (X4) remove the rest. Grid jitter adds no band of its own: the band moves with grid placement (0.093 to 0.238 over the 8 phase grids, mean 0.168), and round 1's grid sat low by chance
decisions.default: S5: sx 1 becomes the default of planCascades3d (measured at stride 8, m 5 at 1080p; stride 16 at 4K). It passes (a) to (f) and meets targets 1, 2 and 4
decisions.door_room: round 7's drop from 0.83 to 0.69 came from pi alone and matches J2's closed-room leak in size: the 0.83 held leaked light. S5 reads 0.94 with error 0.52 (H 0.69, 0.97); its room B shows blotchy noise where H was smooth and dark
nulls_and_misses: D2 prediction failed: the bias sits in the merges, not in the gather
the bounds file's inference from fd 2 was wrong: the kept entries are themselves biased bright, and fd 2 fills only the 10% share sv 2 drops
ss (segment between interval starts) leaves level-0 merges at -5.7%: not built
sx at m 6 misses time (6.53 ms)
S5 raises the closed room at g0 from 0.015% to 0.021% and the fixed grid ph7 from 0.151% to 0.187% (inside the bounds)
door room B under S5 is noisier to the eye than under H
